test_title: PYST 41 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:

The dedicated students, who had been preparing all night, were answering the difficult questions during the final examination.

options.text: The difficult questions were answered by the dedicated students during the final examination.
The difficult questions were being answered by the dedicated students during the final examination.
The difficult questions had been answered by the dedicated students during the final examination.
The difficult questions are being answered by the dedicated students during the final examination.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The dedicated students, who had been preparing all night, were answering the difficult questions during the final examination."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the difficult questions" at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Change the active verb form "were answering" to "were being answered" (past continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the dedicated students."
 
• Retain the time phrase "during the final examination" at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The difficult questions were being answered by the dedicated students during the final examination."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The difficult questions were answered by the dedicated students during the final examination." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive instead of past continuous passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The difficult questions had been answered by the dedicated students during the final examination." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The difficult questions are being answered by the dedicated students during the final examination." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive instead of past continuous passive).
